purpose: Teach: 多数決/同封/空席/値打ち/再選/内輪/詰め込み/関空

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域協議会の、本気で、絶対、多数決、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応、絶対、進めます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll move forward with the local council's decision and have the police take the lead. We truly appreciate your support.
lines.style: Measured and official. Even pacing, steady vocal weight. A slight pause before 'truly appreciate' — genuine, not ceremonial. Composed hands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様への報告書、本気で、絶対、同封、絶対、資料、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've prepared the incident report and supporting documents to forward to the police. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Slightly faster than the officer — eager to confirm understanding. Clear articulation on 'prepared' and 'forward.' Warm undercurrent of compliance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察署の、本気で、絶対、空席、絶対、警察、絶対、補充、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police department is working to fill the current staffing gaps. We're handling this as a priority.
lines.style: Professional, straightforward delivery. Slight emphasis on 'working' and 'priority.' No rush, but no hesitation either. The tone of someone managing logistics without dramatizing them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の安全の、本気で、絶対、値打ち、絶対、当社、絶対、認識、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We recognize that public safety is essential, and our company is committed to supporting that responsibility.
lines.style: Sincere, measured response. Slight warmth on 'essential' — not stiff formality but genuine conviction. Steady eye-contact level. A breath before 'committed' to signal the weight of the statement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域議員の、本気で、絶対、再選、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、対応いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're coordinating with the local representatives and ensuring the police have what they need for proper security coverage.
lines.style: Procedural but assured. Brisk, efficient pacing on the first clause. Slows slightly on 'security coverage' — this is the point that matters. No apology in the tone, only readiness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様からの、本気で、絶対、内輪、絶対、情報、絶対、慎重に、絶対、扱っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling all sensitive information from the police with appropriate discretion and care.
lines.style: Quiet attentiveness. Slightly lower volume on 'sensitive information' — respect for the confidentiality. Careful articulation. No rush. The tone of someone who understands the weight of trust.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気for、絶対、業務、絶対、詰め込み、絶対、過ぎず、絶対、効率化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are managing their workload thoughtfully to avoid overload while improving efficiency. We support that approach.
lines.style: Even, professional tone with light approval underneath. Slight emphasis on 'thoughtfully' — this is not careless speed. Steady rhythm. A small nod in the voice on 'support.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察出張、本気で、絶対、関空、絶対、発、絶対、ご手配、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've arranged the necessary travel and logistics for the police visit to Kansai. Everything is in place.
lines.style: Composed, efficient closing. Brisk but not rushed. Slight satisfaction on 'in place' — the small pride of details handled correctly. Warm closing note, lowering slightly at the end.
